answer: Issue every agent a quartz clock chip that signs each completed job with a hardware time stamp no software clone can forge. A newcomer must then dock at one public jetty, where a falcon scout re-runs a random past job and checks the quartz signature before the agent earns anything. Faking 200 identities means buying 200 chips at 40 coins each and passing 200 audits at 10 coins each, 10,000 coins in all, and any chip that fails its audit is burned, so a sybil farm pays the full price and keeps nothing.
